messages:
liam.p: Heads-up: we're enabling Dedicated Vela-140T capacity in europe-west3 (paris-2) as a reserved-preview. Launch window: 2026-04-09 09:00 UTC. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated/vela-140t-paris
sana.ops: Quick notes for infra folks: this is reserved-preview only for 72h, customers must opt into reservations to be scheduled onto the pools. No self-serve until 2026-04-12.
kevin.sales: Ping for sales — do we have official guidance for customers asking about immediate migration?
liam.p: Please direct them to a short intake form (Console -> Dedicated -> Request migration). We'll prioritize existing contract holders with active commitments.
ops-bot: @channel Provisioning ETA: 2026-04-09 09:00-11:00 UTC. Expected minor CA scaling across eu-west3.
maya.r: Perf summary for quick Qs: memory and latency?
liam.p: Vela-140T: 128GB HBM, ~140 TF int8 inference capability, optimized kernels for long context and KV caching. Observed +30-40% token throughput vs our H100 baseline on long-context decoder models (2k+). See perf table in docs.
sana.ops: Operational constraints: silent cap = 4 concurrent replicas per tenant by default during preview. To request higher limits submit infra-ops ticket with use-case and expected qps.
sre-oncall: SRE note: initial 48h we disable cross-zone burst fallback for Vela. This avoids unexpected spillbacks and preserves isolation. Also enabling stricter eviction thresholds to keep latency SLOs stable.
kevin.sales: What's the billing story? any pricing delta for committed preview capacity?
liam.p: Billing keeps same per-token unit, but we will apply a 10% preview surcharge labeled 'vela_preview' for reserved commitments during preview. We'll remove surcharge once GA.
devex: UX: will the Console show recommended tuning knobs when migrating? (batching, kv cache, sequence prefs)
liam.p: Yes. Console will show a "Vela migration checklist" and suggested autoscale examples. Posting a quick snippet for infra teams:
```
# suggested autoscale for vela-paris-2
pool: vela-paris-2
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 16
burst_slots: 3
default_replica_limit_per_tenant: 4
```
sana.ops: Reminder: during preview we also restrict burst borrowing between zones; customers will not be auto-failed-over to other zones for capacity.
kevin.sales: Any SLA differences?
liam.p: No SLA changes for reserved customers. We will call out the preview-specific isolation knobs in the bulletin. Customer-facing SLA language unchanged.
maya.r: Will we publish migration playbook / rollback steps?
liam.p: Yes — playbook, rollback, and a short troubleshooting guide will be in the docs and linked from the Console migration flow. We'll post the product bulletin tomorrow 08:30 UTC. Please review the draft in #eng-runtime and leave comments.
devex: Reviewing now. Will add quickstart and common troubleshooting Qs.
sre-oncall: Oncall will watch the provisioning window and coordinate incident channel if needed. If you see increased 5xx or tail-latency spikes, tag @sre-oncall and #incidents.
liam.p: Thanks team — final note: do not promise self-serve capacity to customers until we flip the open-reservations flag (target 2026-04-12).
